newsitem.title: MALTA: International banks increase Malta activity.
newsitem.headline: International banks increase Malta activity.

text.p: The consolidated balance sheet of international banking institutions in Malta expanded by 22 percent to 634.4 million Maltese pounds ($1.649 billion) in the third quarter of 1996, compared to 7.7 percent in the second quarter, the Malta Central Bank said.

Foreign liabilities grew by 105.2 million pounds, or 22.2 percent while non-resident deposits dropped by 1.4 percent to 236.4 million pounds. Residents' deposits were up by 2.3 million pounds to 14 million pounds.
Other liabilities grew by 7.3 million pounds to 14.5 million, reflecting growth in offshore banking activity.
The foreign assets portfolio grew by 111.5 million pounds (33.6 percent) to 443.8 million as the institutions reinvested abroad.
Local investments grew by 1.3 percent compared to 9.4 percent in the previous quarter.
